items.name: Barbarian King
items.info: Biggest and bravest of all Barbarians, this colossal menace soaks up huge amounts of damage and smashes anything in his path with his sword. He guards his territory fiercely when defending.

items.name: Archer Queen
items.info: Towering above all other Archers, this graceful huntress is a master of destructive force. Although her health is modest, she snipes targets from afar with her powerful X-Bow. As a defender, she guards the village with a vengeance.

items.name: Grand Warden
items.info: This powerful master of magic supports troops by blasting enemies with his staff! Grand Warden can even walk or fly over walls! He’ll make a majestic stand at his Hero Banner when defending.

items.name: Battle Machine
items.info: The Master Builder's prize invention smashes enemy buildings to bits. What better way is there to show who's the best builder around? Unlock the Electric Hammer ability to give opponents a real pounding!

items.name: Royal Champion
items.info: Over the wall and at them! Royal Champion is only afraid of four things, and the enemy isn't one of them. Her short range is perfect for stabbing defenses up close and personal.

items.name: Battle Copter
items.info: Get to the Copter! Tired of hammering through walls, Master Builder's next-generation flying machine lets him soar over them. The Battle Copter attacks from afar with its powerful Cannons; or can get up close and personal when using its Bomb Rush ability.

items.name: Minion Prince
items.info: This self-proclaimed Prince of Darkness means business! Minion Prince takes to the skies and dishes damage to targets with dark magic! When defending, he can only be attacked by air-targeting enemies.

items.name: Dragon Duke
items.info: Locked away for his anger issues, this tanky flying Hero gets madder and mightier when separated from friendly flying units. His royal rampage boosts damage by 100%, attack speed by 50%, and reduces damage taken from traps. When defending, he can only be attacked by air-targeting enemies.
